name: 7. GPS-Denied Subterranean Rescue (DR Fallback)
description: Survivor trapped in underground basement where GNSS satellite signals are completely blocked. Tests protocol flags switching to MPU-6050 Dead-Reckoning coordinates.

faults.label: Survivor 3 Enters Basement (GNSS Lost, DR Enabled)

expected_behavior: Packet flag bit for GPS is cleared (0), DR flag is set (1). Coordinates reflect dead-reckoning estimate.
